session_memory.scope: Root-owned SSH session with only supervisor/ancestors initially; descendants inherit. Charged-memory peak retains exited tasks but is not summed RSS. No writable hard limit.

own_process_observation.scope: Observed own live VmSwap subtotal; missing/terminated values remain None, never zero. Not a complete process-tree swap peak.

VmSwap_scope: Observed live subtotal; terminated process missing fields are explicit censored None, never0; not a whole-tree peak claim.
